title: Signal: Yarn publish token committed in the configuration
scope: A .yarnrc.yml file that declares a registry token written directly into the checked-in Yarn configuration.
limitations: It matches a registry token written directly into the checked-in Yarn configuration in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .yarnrc.yml that mentions a registry token written directly into the checked-in Yarn configuration in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
